Day 2 shifts to South Beach and the Aquarium District, featuring pristine sandy beaches, fresh seafood at the Fish Market, the renowned Oregon Coast Aquarium, and charming village shops before dinner at a beachfront restaurant. Day 3 showcases the spectacular Otter Crest Scenic Loop, with dramatic tidal formations at Devils Punchbowl, exceptional viewpoints and whale-watching opportunities, and a final scenic dinner to cap your coastal adventure.\n\nYou'll be staying at the Harbor Base Pineapple Inn at just $79 per night ($237 total for three nights), offering exceptional value for a beachfront location. Newport's mild September weather averages 16.1°C with dry conditions—perfect for outdoor exploration without summer crowds.
